def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Solver, Int, sat

    # Variable definitions (merged from base script and constraint sets)
    folio_test_slab = Int('folio_test_slab')
    object = Int('object')

    s = Solver()

    # --- Base script constraints ---
    s.add(folio_test_slab == 0)
    s.add(object == 0)

    # --- Constraint set 1 constraints ---
    # object is NULL (from ZERO_OR_NULL_PTR check)
    s.add(object == 0)
    # folio_test_slab returns 0 (false), so !folio_test_slab is true
    s.add(folio_test_slab == 0)

    # --- Constraint set 2 constraints ---
    # !(unlikely(ZERO_OR_NULL_PTR(object))) => object != 0
    s.add(object != 0)

    # Check satisfiability
    result = s.check()
    return result == sat
